args: Run the scheduled garment generation task for ComfyUI. In directory d:/ai_projects/ComfyUI, execute the command: 'cmd /c D:\ai_projects\ComfyUI\venv\Scripts\python.exe tools/hourly_garment_task.py --count 1'. Ensure it completes and verify the garment is ingested into garment_library/index.json.
description: Every hour at :15 and :45 (Asia/Shanghai), automatically generates 1 unique standalone garment item asset, creates CPU transparent/white/thumb images, and syncs into garment_library and assets.db.
